title: Claims Desk Ruling on Returnless Refunds for Northgate Purchases & Returns
content:
Under Northgate Purchases & Returns, merchandise reported as damaged in transit, not received or missing parts is refunded without coming back only on a channel whose returnless refund reasons include the reported reason, and only when the refunded line amount does not exceed the channel's highest returnless line refund. Larger lines, and every other reason, go through a return authorization under the return terms.

## Ruling 1 — Report deadline

A damaged, missing-part or not-received report qualifies only when it is made no later than the channel's report deadline, in calendar days after the fulfillment date of the purchase. Days are counted as calendar days, the fulfillment date being day 0, and a report on the last day is in time. The basis is the purchase's recorded fulfillment date.

| Hypothetical | Report deadline | Fulfillment date (day 0) | Report made | Qualifies |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 30 days | 1 June | 1 July (day 30) | yes |
| B | 30 days | 1 June | 2 July (day 31) | no |
| C | 2 days | 5 May | 7 May (day 2) | yes |

## Ruling 2 — Claim limit per membership

Member services grants a not-received or damaged-in-transit returnless refund only while the membership's count of such refunds is below the channel's yearly claim allowance. The count covers the rolling 365 calendar days ending today, across every purchase carrying the same membership number, and takes refunds with reason not received or damaged in transit that have no return authorization in status received for their sale line. Beyond that the claim needs a carrier investigation that member services cannot open.

| Allowance | Such refunds in the last 365 days | Member services may grant |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | 1 | yes |
| 2 | 2 | no; carrier investigation needed |

The claim limit does not count missing-parts refunds.

## Ruling 3 — Missing parts

A missing-parts returnless refund covers only the units whose parts are missing, at the sale unit price. Hypothetical: of 10 chairs at 40.00 each on one sale line, 2 arrive missing parts; the returnless refund covers those 2 units at 40.00 each, 80.00 in all.
